audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Akali/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akali/Skill/Skill while the content layer and packet read Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Skill/Akali/Orianna. Rows 0, 1, 2 and 6 disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Command: Attack is 815 range against Five Point Strike at 550, and Twilight Shroud is not available at level 1-3, so Orianna owns the opening levels outright. Late, Akali must dive into the team to function and Shockwave punishes the commit, so row 6 is Orianna.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 6 moved to the content values with their whys rewritten in the same proposal. Rows 4 and 5 deliberately left alone — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes claimed level 6 'doubles your lane presence' and Luden's takes 'a third of a health bar' — magnitudes with no source, and it ignored that level 6 is Akali's spike, not Orianna's.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is a two-part dash with an execute on a 120/90/60 cooldown; that is the spike that decides this lane, not Shockwave.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read Lost Chapter, her Perfect Execution flip at 6, and Luden's restoring shove tempo.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Assassin's Mark auto-reset tell was absent, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit despite being the cooldowns field.
audit.why: Any spell damage rings the target; leaving the ring empowers her next attack with bonus range and damage, so the wind-up as you exit — not the cast — is the moment to be already stepping back. Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s; those two numbers govern every forward step Orianna takes.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now states the Assassin's Mark tell; breakdown.cooldowns carries Shroud's 20s-at-rank-1 and Shuriken Flip's 16s, plus E Command: Protect at 9s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 29 lint findings — 25 misgender (Akali is she/her), 2 copy-paste bleeds in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d, an unsupported 'doubles every gank', and a cooldowns field with no number. Also 'take the fifteen-second invitation' misstated Shroud at 20s rank 1.
audit.why: All deterministic defects from the brief.

notes: Chart rows 4 and 5 LEFT ALONE and flagged: the full layer says Akali wins the 'Level 6' row and Skill wins 'First item', while content win[] (and packet.levelChart) say Skill then Akali. The content whys are themselves shifted — whys[4] talks about level 5 and whys[5] about level 6 — so the two layers are indexing different stages and I cannot tell from the kit which indexing the page renders. Per the chart rule I did not touch either row's side; both whys were rewritten only to remove the misgendering and to name Perfect Execution. Rows 0, 1, 2, 6 were genuinely disagreeing and are now aligned to the content/packet values. Note that no paired win[N] edit accompanies those side moves because win[N] already holds the target string — a before==after edit would be rejected. Rating edits withdrawn: the existing phases[N].rating values track difficulty-for-Orianna (higher = harder), so renumbering them by who-wins-the-row would have inverted the signal. Sides and whys were moved; ratings left as found.
